correctness.rationale: An executable independent double enumeration checks all 4096 arc subsets; 432 including the empty face satisfy exactly the forest criterion. The explicit lexicographic 213-pair matching leaves a single vertex and four 4-cells, and a topological sort of every one of 1500 directed Hasse incidences verifies the gradient is acyclic. By integral discrete Morse theory the complex is a wedge of four 4-spheres. Exact signed fixed-face Euler traces of the six left group actions give character (4,-2,1), and S3 character orthogonality yields two sign copies and one standard copy. Separate boundary ranks modulo 101 and 103 corroborate, but are not substituted for, integral Morse proof.

evidence: Engström Theorem 2.12 applies to directed acyclic graphs. The present graph contains both directed three-cycles and bidirectional spokes.

A distinct indexed result gives the homotopy type of the fully bidirected triangular prism Morse complex as a wedge of 64 four-spheres; its complex has 18 arcs, versus 12 here.

value.rationale: The smallest nonabelian group has a canonical mixed-order generating set, giving a strongly cyclic directed forest complex outside the standard acyclic and tree theorem families. Determining its exact integral homotopy type together with the full nontrivial S3 rational homology character and absence of invariants is a motivated structural base case for Cayley directed-forest topology, not a recomputation of a known table or an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact symmetry calculation distinguishes classes of homology invisible to ordinary Betti numbers.
